text_blocks.snippet: On January 20, 2021, the US stock market saw gains across major indexes, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all reaching record highs. This occurred on the day of President Joe Biden's inauguration. The Dow rose nearly 1% to 31,188, while the Nasdaq climbed nearly 2% to 13,457, and the S&P 500 increased by 1.39% to 3,852.

Several factors contributed to this positive market performance. Investors were anticipating increased fiscal stimulus and a faster nationwide vaccination program. Additionally, strong earnings from large tech companies, particularly in the Nasdaq, played a significant role in its record-breaking performance. The Boeing Company also saw its shares surge due to the lifting of a flight ban on its 737 MAX aircraft.
